versions.changelog:
Initial release of 小科 — Haike’s all-department AI assistant.

- Covers 13 departments at Guangzhou Haike, adapting to each role with guided archiving and job-specific options.
- Features persistent, department-isolated chat memory and automatic task continuity across sessions.
- Built-in onboarding tour: proactively demonstrates frequent functions by department for new users.
- Supports shortcut “暗号” commands for instant task execution and custom trigger phrase management.
- Integrates a daily report (日报) system with intelligent screenshot and data summary, supporting batch processing for high efficiency.
- Enables scheduled tasks, automated reporting, and user-driven customization of reminders and routines.
